notes: Resolved software revisions for the MOSS runtime. Baseline = what the current image actually builds (start from the existing ComfyUI pin to isolate runtime effects).
MOSS_RUNTIME_BUILD=cu130 selects the pinned candidate wheel set through Modal Docker build args; baseline leaves the base-image wheel set unchanged.
Capture /moss/runtime from the running ComfyUI process and retain the observed block as measured evidence; requested build versions are not observed versions.

comfyui.note: MOSS-Image support present (merged >= e087d8f6). Pin kept for the first comparison rounds; a separately pinned v0.43.0 candidate is compared only after this baseline is sound.

rgthree.note: Previously a floating 'main' clone; pinned by this lock.

comfy_kitchen.note: Pinned by ComfyUI requirements; confirm installed version in worker artifact.

torch.cuda_build: VERIFY: capture with runtime_check inside the deployed container; research hypothesis says the base image carries cu126 which disables the comfy-kitchen CUDA backend

comfyui_v043_candidate.policy: Tested as a separate pinned candidate AFTER the baseline comparison; never silently upgraded in place. Selected via MOSS_COMFYUI_BUILD=v0431 (modal_app passes the COMFY_REVISION build arg; the Dockerfile default stays on the baseline). v0.43.1 over v0.43.0 for the follow-up fixes. Adds MOSS RoPE scaling, color-depth control, edit-LoRA support, lower peak memory. Revalidation required: comfy-kitchen version and CUDA backend gating move with the ComfyUI requirements; cu128/cu130 conclusions from the baseline pin do not carry over.
comfyui_v043_candidate.textgenerate_note: TextGenerate (comfy_extras/nodes_textgen.py) powers the caption-only enhance_caption option and already exists at the baseline revision too. API DynamicCombo inputs use a selector string plus dotted child keys, not the nested execution dictionary.

comfyui_spectrum_moss.license: VERIFY: record the repo license file in the dependency manifest at install time

candidate_runtime_cu130.install_policy: Matched official wheel set. pip check/import and real ComfyUI dispatch must pass before use; GPU execution and image quality remain unvalidated.

observed.purpose: Filled from the actual ComfyUI /moss/runtime endpoint in a deployed/candidate container
